inputs.title: Enablement (Centralized Configuration Management)
inputs.content_preview:
| **Enablement** | Jason Aggee Mar-11-2026 5m 28a  --- |
| --- | --- |
| **UI** | UI is in AAC  Config for Controller, Worker, Gallery  Config Controller  Config a Worker  Get the Worker PhoneHome file.  Tells the Server who to contact to get the configuration  Place file on Controller  Get Launch file for a Worker  Place on the Worker  When Service starts, it reaches out for its config and creates/updates RuntimeSettings.xml  Can still go to Alteryx System Settings  Reports  Central log access

routing.review_reason: New taxonomy node 'administration' required under 'product-tree/alteryx-server/administration' — pending taxonomy approval
routing.proposal_rationale: Server administration spans system settings, AlteryxService diagnostics, command-line tools, disk cleanup, logging, health checks, load balancers, and cloud deployment. An 'administration' subtree organizes this operational domain.
